name: Victorica de Valdana
source:
Queen of Valdana, renowned for her strategic skill and stern character as the "Blaze Queen".
She led the revolution that deposed her despotic brother and now enjoys unprecedented support from the masses.
A progressive ruler who holds the Alliance in high regard while looking down on the Loptr Church for the support it gave to her brother's rule and previous involvements in shady businesses.
